description.value: Daikichi Sushi is a compact Japanese restaurant on Burrard Street in Vancouver offering a broad menu of sushi rolls, sashimi, ramen, teriyaki bowls, and tempura. The shop supports online ordering with a pickup window, making it a practical quick-stop option. Vegetarian diners are well accommodated with dedicated tofu, vegetable, and plant-based menu items throughout the menu.
